description: Add mode indicator banner, improve color contrast, enhance detection UI, implement snapshot freeze (10s), and add per-person tracking in contador mode
steps: 1. In src/components/FaceDetector.tsx, change SNAPSHOT_DISPLAY_MS from 5000 to 10000 to freeze the image for 10 seconds in snapshot mode.

2. In src/app/page.tsx, add a MODE INDICATOR BANNER between the person-count card and the event name section. For 'contador' mode: use a vivid indigo/blue banner with Users icon showing 'MODO CONTADOR - Rastreo por persona'. For 'snapshot' mode: use a vivid emerald/green banner with Camera icon showing 'MODO SNAPSHOT - Captura + Poema'. The banner should be prominent, with a pill/badge style, distinct background color, and slightly pulsing dot indicator.

3. In src/components/FaceDetector.tsx, update the getEmotionBg() function to use brighter, more vivid gradient colors that contrast well against dark backgrounds. Suggested replacements: happy='#fbbf24, #f59e0b' (brighter amber), sad='#60a5fa, #818cf8' (brighter blue/indigo), angry='#f87171, #ef4444' (brighter red), surprised='#fb923c, #f97316' (brighter orange), disgusted='#4ade80, #22c55e' (brighter green), fearful='#c084fc, #a855f7' (brighter purple), neutral='#9ca3af, #6b7280' (brighter gray).

4. In src/components/FaceDetector.tsx, update the detection panel (the grid showing 'Persona 1', 'Persona 2' etc.) to use tracked face IDs instead of sequential indices. Change label from 'Persona {i+1}' to 'per{trackedId}' format. Pass the tracked IDs through - the detection loop already returns faceIds from updateTracking(). Store faceIds in component state alongside detectedFaces so the panel can map face[i] to faceId[i].

5. In src/components/FaceDetector.tsx, implement per-person emotion history tracking for CONTADOR mode. Add a ref (personEmotionHistoryRef) that maps person ID to an array of {emotion, timestamp} entries. When a tracked person's emotion changes, log it (e.g., per1 triste -> per1 feliz). Include this per-person emotion history in the capture data sent to the API.

6. Update the CaptureData interface in src/components/FaceDetector.tsx and the POST handler in src/app/api/captures/route.ts to accept an optional 'personEmotions' field (array of {personId: string, emotions: {emotion: string, timestamp: string}[]}). The existing 'emotions' jsonb column in the DB already accepts any JSON, so this richer data structure will be stored there when in contador mode.

7. In the detection panel cards (src/components/FaceDetector.tsx), improve visual contrast: use brighter text colors (text-white instead of text-gray-400 for emotion labels), add a subtle colored left border or background tint based on the person's current emotion, and increase the card background opacity for better readability.

8. In the snapshot overlay (src/components/FaceDetector.tsx), ensure the snapshot also saves the capture data to the DB when it triggers. Add a call to saveCapture() inside triggerSnapshot() with the snapshot-specific data (including the dominant emotion, poem text, and face count).
9. In src/app/globals.css, add a new animation class 'animate-mode-pulse' with a gentle pulsing glow effect for the mode indicator banner.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build passes with no TypeScript errors
Mode indicator banner is visible above the detection area showing current mode with distinct color (indigo for contador, emerald for snapshot)
Snapshot mode freezes the display for 10 seconds (SNAPSHOT_DISPLAY_MS = 10000)
Detection panel shows 'per{id}' labels based on tracked face IDs instead of sequential 'Persona 1' labels
Contador mode tracks per-person emotion changes and includes personEmotions data in captures sent to the API
getEmotionBg() uses brighter gradient colors that are visible on dark backgrounds
Detection panel cards have improved contrast with brighter text and colored accent per emotion
Snapshot mode saves capture data to the DB when triggered
POST /api/captures accepts optional personEmotions field without breaking existing captures
verification: Run: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && cd /projects/sandbox/emociones-app && npm run build
findings: Build passes cleanly. Review fixes applied: (1) personEmotionHistoryRef is now flushed after each auto-save cycle to prevent unbounded growth. (2) snapshotImage (base64 JPEG) is now included in CaptureData and saved to a dedicated snapshot_image text column. (3) emotions column always stores the flat array; personEmotions stored in a separate person_emotions jsonb column for consistent schema. (4) Face ID index coupling documented with a comment. (5) personEmotions validated in the API route before DB insert. Migration script updated with ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS for both new columns. POST-COMPLETION BUG FIXES: (a) Removed emotion message card from contador mode UI - it was incorrectly showing poem-like messages that belong only in snapshot overlay. (b) Lowered snapshot confidence threshold from 0.3 to 0.15 for better triggering. (c) Added 1.5s stabilization delay after mode switch to let detection confidence settle.
